en.title: Xi'an to Chengdu: Train or Flight, and Which Hub?
en.headline: Xi'an and Chengdu: Rail Hubs, Flight Exceptions and Door-to-Door Time
en.description: Choose rail or air between Xi'an and Chengdu in either direction by full station name, airport terminal, luggage, security, city last mile and what the published rules let you do when it goes wrong.
